method: OpenAI imagegen; newly drawn poses using project-created fan art

Row1: neutral, windup/anticipation, ranged release. Row2: melee release, hit reaction from right (body hunches LEFT with limbs braced, no extra attacker), recovery toward neutral. Movement must redraw jaws, limbs, knees and torso anatomically, NOT warp the entire body. Preserve all horns, armor and limb counts. Do not mirror reference designs. Ranged and melee poses details: SkullGreymon: ivory dinosaur skeleton with large dorsal missile launcher. Windup bends knees and bows head so back-mounted launcher aims RIGHT. Release braces legs, launcher points right, spine flexed naturally, open skeletal jaw. Melee bony claws swipe right. Hit skull recoils left, ribcage twists, limbs curl. Preserve skeletal anatomy, no flesh.
